held_out_575.rule: #556 frozen realizations, buckets, failure rules and limits unchanged; a form qualifies only if every Robinson-Bower and Dinane-Mounir bucket passes under every realization with no native failure (robust_passed). Rard-Miller buckets are training rows and are reported, not judged.
held_out_575.amendment: 2026-10-16, owner decision after both stage-A runs and their held-out verdicts (Engine issue #575 comment of 2026-10-16): judge Dinane-Mounir by source agreement. Above I = 3 the training source Rard-Miller, converted to water activity at the Dinane-Mounir compositions (scripts/consistency.py, source arithmetic only), disagrees with the held-out Dinane-Mounir measurements by more than the frozen 0.0013 RMS limit, so no model trained on Rard-Miller can meet it. For each Dinane-Mounir bucket (I <= 3, I > 3) and each frozen realization, the RMS limit is the larger of 0.0013 and the RMS source disagreement, and the maximum-error limit the larger of 0.0040 and the maximum source disagreement, both on the same rows and the same realization (a realization perturbs only its own source, as in compare.py). Applied by scripts/evaluate.py to the existing optima without refitting. The fits, optima, selection rule, Robinson-Bower limits and every other criterion are unchanged. The fit records' declaration_sha256 names this file before the amendment.

owner_qualification.decision: Owner decision (Engine issue #575 comment of 2026-10-16): qualify the Figiel-form refit trained with Saad 1980 for NaCl-MgCl2-CaCl2 chloride brines at 298.15 K, over the ionic-strength range of the training and held-out data, although it fails the rule above in one realization; record that realization and its numbers as the qualification limit. The Held form stays unqualified. The fits, optima, selection, limits and computed verdicts (selection.json qualified) are unchanged.
